position_out_rates.source: nflverse injuries (official NFL injury report fields)
position_out_rates.note: Out rate = share of injury-report entries whose game status is 'Out'. Wilson 95% intervals are shown because most positions are statistically indistinguishable from the pooled rate at this sample size; only rows with distinguishably_above_pooled = true have a demonstrably higher rate.

depth_vacancies.method: depth_team == '1' from the published depth chart joined to game status 'Out' from the injury report, same team and week

backup_deficiency.why_unverified: rosters.csv reports zero starts for every player from 2019 onward (upstream field not populated), so the metric cannot be computed and is left blank rather than estimated.
backup_deficiency.definition: share of a team's season starts made by players with <= 1 prior season
